reason: Touches privilege cache invalidation and grant/revoke/session notification paths (`pkg/privilege/**`, `pkg/executor/{grant,revoke,simple}.go`, `pkg/session/session.go`, plus `pkg/domain/domain.go`). A change that avoids notifying all users can easily create stale or incorrectly refreshed privilege state, which is a high-blast-radius privilege-enforcement/runtime-correctness risk.
